spice.model: .model D1N4148WT D(IS=5.5e-11 N=1.85 RS=1.0 BV=75 IBV=5u CJO=0.57p TT=4n)
spice.source: fitted to the typical forward voltage at 25 °C of the graph 'Forward Voltage vs Ambient Temperature' (p. 2, read from the graph): 0.80 V at 1 mA, 0.92 V at 10 mA (N 1.85, IS 5.5e-11 A), 1.12 V at 100 mA (RS 1.0 Ω), 1.25 V at 200 mA; BV the VRRM, IBV at IR 5 µA; CJO from the capacitance graph (0.57 pF at 0 V), TT from trr 4 ns (assumption: TT ≈ trr)

sources: Fairchild (onsemi) 1N4148WT / 1N4448WT / 1N914BWT datasheet, Rev. A2 (September 2009), LCSC's copy https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/bed5775b3e24a382b80d4f522916afbc.pdf, read 2026-10-31
p. 1: SOD-523F, band = cathode; absolute maximum VRSM and VRRM 75 V, IFRM 300 mA (repetitive peak), TJ −55 … +150 °C; PD 200 mW, RθJA 500 °C/W (FR-4, minimum land pad)
electrical characteristics: VF ≤ 1 V at 10 mA (1N4148WT); IR ≤ 25 nA at 20 V, ≤ 5 µA at 75 V; CO ≤ 4 pF; trr ≤ 4 ns
pin names K, A and numbers 1 K, 2 A as the Corne's KiCad symbol Diode:1N4148WT

checked: absolute maximum ratings and thermal characteristics
open: no continuous forward current rating: the sheet gives only IFRM 300 mA (repetitive peak) – if_max_a stays out; PD 200 mW and RθJA 500 °C/W hold the diode (LIM.p, LIM.t)
